title: mview CSV view
brief: CSV/TSV table view inside the Workbench shell (S13): sticky header, three-state sort, JSON-style search with Clear and the `<shown> of <total> rows` status count, ragged rows and Column <n>, long cells cut with an ellipsis, right-aligned numeric columns, column Outline, the 5,000-row notice, light and dark theme.

artboards.title: Compact grid
artboards.tradeoff: Spreadsheet density: mono cells, cell borders and a file-row gutter fit about twice the rows on screen; needs tighter padding than the .md table S13 says to reuse, and is harder on long text

artboards.title: Comfortable rows
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to S13: Markdown table padding and colours, zebra rows and number/text hints in the header and Outline; fewer rows per screen, long values only on hover

artboards.title: Table and inspector
artboards.tradeoff: JSON two-pane layout: the selected row's full values (incl. cut cells, empty cells and Column 6) in an Inspector; adds row selection and a panel S13 does not ask for, and 340px less table width
